newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London steady, HSBC gains.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London steady, HSBC gains.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks were steady to firmer in London on Tuesday with heavyweight banking group HSBC Holdings featuring in an otherwise quiet session, dealers said.
HSBC gained HK$2.00 to close HK$232.00, dragged higher by another strong performance by shares in UK banks.
The Hong Kong London Reference index rose 8.25 points to close at 14,447.96 after the Hang Seng index suffered a bout of profit taking in Hong Kong and fell 215.42 points to finish at 14,439.71.
HK Telecom also featured falling 35 cents to HK$17.00, as earlier profit-taking in Hong Kong spilled over into London trading.

Dealers said the profit-taking in Hong Kong was a delayed reaction to news last week that Cable and Wireless had agreed to sell a 5.5 percent stake in HK Telecom to China Telecom for HK$14.25 per share.
